This Land Acquisition Appeal Having Been Finally Heard On 05.06.2025,
The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:
 La.App. No. 65 Of 2019
 2
 2025:Ker:40825
 Judgment
1.
This Appeal is filed by the respondent in the LAR No.15/2015.
LAR No.15/2015 was disposed of along with six other L.A.Rs by a common judgment.

An extent of 12.35 Ares of land belonging to the respondents/claimants was acquired for the Kallada Irrigation Project as per Section 4(1)
Notification dated 11.02.1982 under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation fixing the land value @ Rs.2,545/- per Are.
The claimants filed Application under Section 28A before the District Collector and the District Collector awarded compensation fixing the land value @ Rs.4,940/- per Are.
2. The Reference Court awarded compensation fixing the land value @ Rs.6,000/- per Are.

3. When the matter was taken for consideration, the learned Senior Government Pleader Sri. Rekha C. Nair confirmed that as against the judgments in LAR No.49/2014 & 9/2016 which LA.APP. NO.
65 OF 2019 2025:KER:40825 were disposed of along with LAR No.15/2015 as per the common judgment, the State has not filed any appeal.
In the said case also, the Reference Court had fixed land value @ Rs.6,000/- per Are.
The said judgment, which has become final, is applicable in this case.
I do not find any ground or reason to interfere with the judgment passed by the Reference Court.
